page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Expose the minimum configuration surface needed to understand and operate Lighting Control safely.

states.description: Backend and saved policy status are being checked.
Shows explicit backend readiness, last check, and saved policy guardrails.
Saved policy is not available; the page does not invent setup success.
Backend status is available while one or more optional preferences are not configured.
Backend or policy errors are actionable and do not erase the last known values.
Last check time remains visible so old readiness is not presented as current.
